column5: Tracking URIs pass through session.expandUri() (M 716, S 274-299). CACHEBUSTING is 8 random digits with leading zeros kept (S 283-285).
LIMITADTRACKING is not in the macro table, so the fallback writes -1 (S 298). This conforms only under the harness's lenient -1/-2 acceptance. It is not a 0/1 value.
Values are passed through encodeURIComponent (S 297-298). The cell becomes gradable once M02 conforms.

Every bracketed token that is not in the table is replaced with -1: the pattern is /\[([A-Z0-9_]+)\]|%5B...%5D/gi with || '-1' (S 296-298). Section 6.1 of the specification says to leave unknown macros alone. The same fallback writes -1 for [ERRORCODE] (see E03, E05, E06 in section 4).

column3: deviates: not replaced or implausible: ah="[ADPLAYHEAD]", asi="[ADSERVINGID]", ...
column5: The optional macros of the vector are filled or set to -1 by the same macro table and fallback (S 284-298).
ADPLAYHEAD is filled from the session's ad-time clock (S 274-299). The cell becomes gradable once M06 conforms.
Error URIs go through the same sendBeacon and expandUri path (M 716-722)

column3: deviates: misattributed: p1 imp 1 complete 0; p2 imp 1 complete 1; p3 imp 1 complete 2
column4: conforms: one impression and one complete per ad (3 ads)
column5: complete() sends AD_COMPLETE for its own interstitial before basicTask() sets up the next ad (M 1455-1466). Each ad also gets its own session and tracker (M 710-725; the header of S reads: "a callback from an earlier ad cannot track the next ad in a pod"). In 5.2.12, complete fired after the next ad became lastPlayedAd_. On the wire, each pod ad gets its own complete.

column3: deviates: impression requested for an ad that never played
column5: Impression, start and loaded beacons are held back until the session sees real playback: readyState >= 2 and a timeupdate (S 149-167). notify() drops anything other than loaded or error before that point (S 225). In 5.2.12 they fired at ad setup, before media load.

A volumechange that does not change the muted state is tagged muteChanged=false (M 1581-1587) and not tracked (M 2335-2337, S 235-239). In 5.2.12, every non-muted volumechange fired unmute (5.2.12 ad_utils.js 161).
